mapper.select: SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM community_post_review r JOIN post p ON p.post_id=r.post_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_housephoto h JOIN post p ON p.post_id=h.post_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_housedecoration d JOIN post p ON p.post_id=d.post_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.is_deleted=0 ) x

SELECT post_id AS post_id, review_id AS review_id, review_title AS review_title, review_content AS review_content, review_date AS review_date, review_count AS review_count, review_like_count AS review_like_count, /* ▼ 삭제되지 않은 댓글 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.target_id = community_post_review.post_id AND c.target_type = 'COMMUNITY_REVIEW' AND c.is_deleted = 0 ) AS comment_count FROM community_post_review ORDER BY post_id DESC

SELECT p.post_id, r.review_id, r.review_title, r.review_content, p.post_date AS review_date, p.post_count AS review_count, p.post_like_count AS review_like_count, /* ▼ 삭제되지 않은 댓글 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.target_id = p.post_id AND c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ) AS comment_count FROM post p JOIN community_post_review r ON p.post_id = r.post_id WHERE p.target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY p.post_date DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{count}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE target_type = #{targetType}
